10-Day Delphi, Petra & Wadi Rum Heritage Tour
summary:
The 10-Day Jordan & Greece Tour combines Jordan’s desert and archaeological highlights with Greece’s classical heritage. Begin in Amman before traveling south to Petra, spending time in Wadi Rum and at the Dead Sea. The journey then continues to Athens, where ancient landmarks provide a different historical setting, followed by a full-day visit to Delphi and its sanctuary in the mountains. The route keeps Jordan focused on its major southern sites while giving Greece a concise mainland extension.
The escorted program operates from April to October and includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, professional local guides, entrance fees, airport transfers and land transportation between destinations.

itinerary.title: Arrival to Amman
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Queen Alia Airport. Meet our representative and transfer to your hotel in Amman.
Hotel check-in after The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Amman, Jerash and Aljoun
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a panoramic city tour of Amman. Visit the historic Amman Citadel, the impressive Roman Theatre, and the Folklore Museum. Continue to Ajloun Castle before proceeding to Jerash to explore Hadrian’s Arch, the Hippodrome, and the well-preserved Roman ruins. Return to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Visit Madaba, Mt Nebo and Kerak
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Drive to Madaba and visit St. George’s Church. Continue to Mount Nebo for panoramic views over the Jordan Valley and the Dead Sea. Drive through the scenic Wadi Mujib mountains to Karak and visit the famous Kerak Castle. Continue to Petra. Overnight in Petra.

itinerary.title: Visit Petra and Wadi Rum
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Visit Petra, the famous rose-red city of the Nabataean civilization. Enjoy an optional horse ride through the narrow Siq canyon to reach the spectacular Al-Khazneh (Treasury). Continue to the Street of Facades, Royal Tombs, and Pharaoh’s Castle. Later, drive to Wadi Rum, also known as the Valley of the Moon, and enjoy an exciting 4x4 jeep safari through the desert landscape. Dinner and overnight in a desert camp.

itinerary.title: Visit Dead Sea,and then return Amman
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Drive to the Dead Sea, the lowest point on Earth. Enjoy free time to relax and float in the salty mineral-rich waters before continuing your drive back to Amman. Overnight in Amman.

itinerary.title: Amman to Athens by flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out. Transfer to Airport for your flight to Athens.
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Athens City tour
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Start a city tour of Athens, including visits to the Acropolis of Athens, the Acropolis Museum, and the famous Parthenon. Continue to see the Hellenic Parliament, the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, and the National Library. Visit the Presidential Mansion to watch the Evzones Guards, then continue to the Panathenaic Stadium, the Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Hadrian's Arch. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Full day Saronic Island Cruise
itinerary.text: Transfer to Port of Piraeus for embarkation on the cruise boat. Sail to Hydra and enjoy free time for walking, shopping, or swimming. Continue to Poros with short free time to explore and enjoy views of Poros Town. Lunch will be served onboard during the cruise. Sail to Aegina with free time for walking or swimming, weather permitting. Return to Athens. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Delphi Sightseeing Tour
itinerary.text: Depart from Athens and drive through the fertile plain of Boeotia, passing Thebes, Livadeia, and the mountain village of Arachova. Continue to the Delphi Archaeological Site and explore the Sanctuary of Apollo. Visit the famous Temple of Apollo and the Treasury of the Athenians before continuing to the impressive Delphi Archaeological Museum. After the tour, return to Athens. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Athens Airport
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel and check out.
Transfer to Athens International Airport for your return flight home.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the Jordan and Greece Highlights – 10 Days tour?
faqs.a: The Jordan and Greece Highlights tour covers Athens and Delphi in Greece, along with Amman, Petra, Wadi Rum, and the Dead Sea in Jordan. This itinerary combines the ancient heritage of Greece with Jordan's remarkable archaeological sites and desert landscapes, offering an unforgettable journey through two fascinating countries. The tour runs for 9 nights and 10 days.

faqs.q: How much does the Jordan and Greece Highlights – 10 Days tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,475 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and one domestic flight. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, one domestic flight is included within the itinerary. Additional transportation between destinations is provided according to the tour program. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Greece and Jordan. Daily breakfast is included, and additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Greece and Jordan. Your guides will provide fascinating insights into the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece and Jordan?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines the most famous highlights of both countries, providing an excellent introduction to their rich history, culture, and natural beauty.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historical districts, and desert landscapes. Petra requires extensive walking, while most other sightseeing activities are suitable for visitors with average fitness levels.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Acropolis and Parthenon in Athens, the UNESCO-listed archaeological site of Delphi, the vibrant capital city of Amman, the spectacular rose-red city of Petra, the dramatic desert landscapes of Wadi Rum, and the relaxing floating experience at the Dead Sea.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Jordan and Greece Highlights – 10 Days tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the Jordan and Greece Highlights – 10 Days tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include additional Greek islands, add destinations such as Jerash, Aqaba, or Santorini, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
